results.title: Nepal PM Balendra Shah arrives in Delhi for first official visit to India
results.content: The PMs of India and Nepal are set to hold talks on Monday, with sources saying the discussion will give 'political direction' to bilateral relations for the coming years

results.title: Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy: Sachin dazzles in Tamil Nadu’s big win over Bihar
results.content: The opener smashes 82 off 41 balls while Sai Kishore and Siddharth excel with the ball; Tejasvi runs riot for Delhi; Alam scalps four in four as Railways ends Saurashtra’s winning streak

results.title: Giving India’s first practising woman doctor her due: Kadambini Ganguly​
results.content: Kadambini Ganguly broke barriers to become one of India’s first women physicians to practise Western medicine

results.title: India, China hold 10-day talks to ease LoAC tensions in Arunachal Pradesh
results.content: The talks focused on establishing engagement protocols, preventing face-offs and misunderstandings between troops deployed along the frontier, and maintaining open communication channels

results.title: Temperature in Mumbai drops by about 5 degrees in a day
results.content: Santacruz recorded 16.2°C on Saturday, the second-lowest November reading in the past 10 years, while Pune’s Shivajinagar logged the winter’s lowest so far

results.title: COP 31 talks fail as EU, others reject any climate deal without language on a fossil fuel phase-out
results.content: EU, Panama among about 130 parties that refuse to accept COP President’s consensus cover text, alleges that it “greenwashes” fossil fuels; India, China, Saudi Arabia are on the other side of the divide
